title: Mail network: owner-chosen newsletters skip the second approval
goal: A mail the owner classifies as a newsletter reaches Archive preview without a second IdP approval, while newsletters classified automatically keep the approval gate; composition changes become possible again through an owner-reviewed path.
summary: The change proposed in the issue (choice option `newsletter` → `mail.approved`) is rejected by the current validator, because an approved channel may only be produced by its approval gate. This plan keeps that safety rule: owner-chosen newsletters get their own channel into a new Archive preview version, and Codex prepares the composition replacement that the owner reviews and applies in the desktop Decisions tab.

problem.statement: Every mail the owner classifies as a newsletter candidate is shown to him again in the IdP approval batch.
problem.impact: The owner decides the same mail twice and perceives the network as repeating itself; the desktop currently cannot change a running network's composition at all.
problem.approach: Route owner-chosen newsletters through a separate channel and restore composition replacement as a Codex-prepared, owner-confirmed decision.
problem.outcome: One decision per owner-chosen newsletter; automatic newsletters still need IdP approval; every composition change has a reviewed diff and a receipt.

context: Issue 1451 records the owner decision of October 7, 2026 ("Deine Wahl genügt"). Inspection used canonical main 930a8ee5 in an isolated worktree and a read-only MCP `networks detail` of the installed Delta Mind mail network b95f1f8a revision 3 (active; 2 open choices, 1 pending approval batch with 11 held items, 11 pending deliveries). Facts: Archive preview (129579b8) has contract takes [mail.approved], gives [] and is bound to approve route `newsletter-approval` (takes mail.batch, gives mail.approved, excluded mail.excluded). `validateNetworkRoutes` (apps/openape-pods/src/contracts/networks.ts) throws "Approved output cannot have another producer" when a choose option targets an approve route's output, and the bound consumer subscribes to `mail.batch` through the gate, so events on `mail.approved` from another producer would not even be delivered. `NetworkReplacement` (worker) still provides preview/replace with fingerprint, settlement checks and a trace receipt; the redesign removed its UI (NetworkReplacement.vue in 76c0f84b) and the Codex MCP refuses composition changes. `updateMemberScript` (issue 1445) refuses contract changes. This is a proposal; no implementation approval is inferred.
scope: Codex MCP networks: a write command that prepares a composition replacement for a paused network and stores it as a pending owner review with the worker's preview fingerprint; Codex can never apply it.

Desktop Decisions tab: a composition-change item with the exact before/after diff (channels, routes, gates, members added/retired), open settlement issues, and Apply/Discard; applying calls the existing replaceComposition with the reviewed fingerprint. Activation stays the separate existing control.

Mail network revision 4: new channel mail.owner-newsletter (same schema as mail.unsure); choice option newsletter gives it; a new Archive preview definition version takes [mail.approved, mail.owner-newsletter] as a fresh instance bound to the unchanged newsletter-approval gate; the old instance is retired with its history.
nonGoals: Relaxing the rule that an approved channel has exactly one producer, or letting Pods auto-release items at an approval gate.
Composition review in the browser or the mobile inbox; it stays a desktop decision. Rights, activation and actual mail moves remain unchanged and separately approved.
Changing Categorisation, Newsletter batch or the automatic newsletter path.

decisions.title: Owner choice suffices for self-classified newsletters
decisions.description: Mails the owner classified as newsletters skip the IdP approval; the gate remains for newsletters classified by the Categorisation Pod. Any later step that really moves mail needs its own approval.

decisions.title: Recommended: separate channel instead of a validator exception
decisions.description: Option A (recommended): channel `mail.owner-newsletter` into a new Archive preview version; keeps "everything on mail.approved was IdP-approved" and needs no engine change. Option B: allow a declared choose option to feed an approve route's output; requires changing the validator and the gate-bound subscription for every network. Option C (rejected): the gate auto-releases items with owner-choice ancestry; Pods would approve on the owner's behalf.

decisions.title: Codex prepares, the owner applies
decisions.description: Matches the redesign rule that creation goes through Codex and the owner decides in the Decisions tab. The stored review binds the worker fingerprint, so any change to the network, its rights or its pending work invalidates it.

milestones.title: Confirm the target composition on a synthetic network
milestones.goal: Prove option A is valid before building the review path.
steps: Extend the existing replacement test (test/scheduling/network-migration.test.ts) with a fixture shaped like the mail network: replace a gate-bound sink by a fresh instance taking [approved, owner-chosen], retire the old one, and move the choose option.
Read the installed Archive preview script read-only to confirm it handles input independent of the channel name; otherwise note the minimal script change for the new version.
acceptance: The replacement preview has no issues; after activation an owner newsletter choice reaches the new sink without a gate task, while an automatic batch item still creates one.
milestones.rollback: Test-only; drop the test and fall back to an owner decision on option B.

milestones.title: Codex prepares composition replacements
milestones.goal: Give Codex a bounded write that only creates a pending owner review.
steps: Add prepareReplacement {id, revision, draft} to codex-networks.ts; the worker runs replacementPreview, stores draft, fingerprint, issues, added and retired in the hidden Codex review scope (reusing change sets, like the existing workflow review) and returns the preview; replaceComposition stays refused for MCP.
Document the command, preconditions (paused, settled) and receipt in the runtime reference so Codex can prepare it without guessing.
acceptance: Contract and worker tests: Codex can prepare and re-prepare, cannot apply, and a prepared review is refused at apply time after any fingerprint change.
milestones.rollback: Revert the PR; the MCP returns to read/pause/preview/process only; stored pending reviews are ignored.

milestones.title: Owner reviews and applies in the Decisions tab
milestones.goal: Show exactly what changes and apply only the reviewed version.
steps: Add a composition-change section to DecisionsInbox (desktop only; the browser shows that it waits on the desktop) using the existing compositionDiff helper; Apply sends replaceComposition with the stored fingerprint, Discard retires the review.
German and English labels; remove the unused renderer helper parts that stay unused.
acceptance: Component tests: diff content, issues block Apply, Apply/Discard emit the exact commands, stale fingerprint shows the worker error.
Pods unit/component suite, root lint and typecheck pass; layout check of the new section at desktop and narrow width with inspected screenshots in a private Test Run.
milestones.rollback: Revert the PR and reinstall the previous signed desktop build.

milestones.title: Apply revision 4 to the Delta Mind mail network
milestones.goal: Deliver the owner decision on the installed desktop.
steps: Signed desktop release with profile backup. Codex creates the new Archive preview definition version as a fresh Pod, pauses the network, and lists the open settlement items; the owner decides open choices and the pending approval batch.
Codex prepares revision 4; the owner reviews the diff, applies and reactivates the network.
acceptance: Trace shows composition-replaced-reviewed for revision 4; the next owner newsletter choice reaches Archive preview without an IdP batch item; the next automatic newsletter still appears in an approval batch; no mail is moved.
milestones.rollback: Pause, have Codex prepare the revision-3 composition with a fresh instance of the old definition, owner applies; history of both instances stays preserved.

risks.title: The network cannot settle
risks.mitigation: The preview lists the exact blocking items; the owner decides them before applying. Nothing is cancelled automatically.

risks.title: Archive preview state is lost with the fresh instance
risks.mitigation: M0 inspects the checkpoint; the retired instance keeps its history and records. If state matters, M3 carries it over through the new definition's initial configuration, never by editing the database.

risks.title: Signed fixture runs wait for a keychain prompt
risks.mitigation: Until issue 1450 lands, detect the SecurityAgent hang early and report it immediately instead of waiting.

entries.source: Issue 1451 records the owner decision of October 7, 2026 ("Deine Wahl genügt"). Inspection used canonical main 930a8ee5 in an isolated worktree and a read-only MCP `networks detail` of the installed Delta Mind mail network b95f1f8a revision 3 (active; 2 open choices, 1 pending approval batch with 11 held items, 11 pending deliveries). entries.text: Issue 1451 hält die Owner-Entscheidung vom 7. Oktober 2026 fest ("Deine Wahl genügt"). Grundlage: kanonisches main 930a8ee5 in einem isolierten Worktree und ein lesendes MCP-`networks detail` des installierten Delta-Mind-Mail-Netzes b95f1f8a Revision 3 (aktiv; 2 offene Auswahlfragen, 1 offener Freigabe-Batch mit 11 gehaltenen Einträgen, 11 ausstehende Zustellungen). Fakten: Archive preview (129579b8) hat den Vertrag takes [mail.approved], gives [] und ist an die Approve-Route `newsletter-approval` gebunden (takes mail.batch, gives mail.approved, excluded mail.excluded). `validateNetworkRoutes` (apps/openape-pods/src/contracts/networks.ts) wirft "Approved output cannot have another producer", wenn eine Choose-Option den Ausgang einer Approve-Route befüllt; außerdem abonniert der gebundene Empfänger `mail.batch` über das Gate, Ereignisse eines anderen Produzenten auf `mail.approved` kämen also gar nicht an. `NetworkReplacement` (Worker) bietet weiterhin Vorschau/Ersetzung mit Fingerprint, Ruhezustandsprüfung und Trace-Quittung; das Redesign hat die Oberfläche entfernt (NetworkReplacement.vue in 76c0f84b), und das Codex-MCP verweigert Änderungen der Zusammensetzung. `updateMemberScript` (Issue 1445) verweigert Vertragsänderungen. Dies ist ein Vorschlag; eine Freigabe zur Umsetzung wird nicht abgeleitet.
